concerns.text: Task T015.1-Run (Execute Asset Generation) is listed as a dependency for T015 and T016, but T015.1-Run is marked [P] (parallel-safe) alongside T015.1-Script. However, T015.1-Run depends on T015.1-Script. The current ordering implies T015.1-Run could theoretically start before T015.1-Script completes if the [P] tag is interpreted as 'no dependencies', violating the producer-consumer flow. The [P] tag on T015.1-Run is semantically incorrect as it has a hard dependency on T015.1-Script.

Task T006.1-LoadSubset is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but has a hard dependency on the existence of `data/stimuli/raw_subset/` and `manifest.sha256` which are not created by any preceding task in the list. While the plan mentions a 'pre-bundled subset', the task list lacks a 'Setup Data Bundle' task to create/populate this directory before T006.1-LoadSubset runs. T006.1-LoadSubset cannot execute in parallel with setup tasks if the data doesn't exist yet.

Task T015 (Enhanced detail compositing) depends on T015.1-Run (assets exist). Task T016 (Reduced detail) also depends on T015.1-Run. However, T016 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) in the list. T016 cannot be parallel-safe with T015 if they both consume the same asset pool generated by T015.1-Run without explicit locking or if they write to the same output directory structure without isolation. The [P] tag on T016 is risky without explicit file-path isolation guarantees.

Task T035 (Implement Repeated-Measures ANOVA) lists T012-Runtime as a dependency. T012-Runtime is a 'Gate' task that raises SystemExit if power is insufficient. If T012-Runtime fails, T035 should not run. However, T035 is listed in Phase 5, while T012-Runtime is in Phase 2. The ordering is correct, but the [P] tag on T035 (if present in a future revision) would be invalid as it depends on the successful completion of a blocking gate task.

Task T006.2-Calc and T006.3-Filter are marked [P] but T006.3-Filter explicitly depends on T006.2-Calc ('Dependency: T006.2-Calc'). The [P] tag on T006.3-Filter is semantically incorrect as it cannot run in parallel with T006.2-Calc.
